findings.summary: The skip link targets #main, but no in-scope main is focusable. Turbo Drive focuses that element and then removes a temporary tabindex, so keyboard focus does not remain in the main content.
findings.fix: Add tabindex="-1" to every <main id="main">. Turbo View#focusElement keeps an existing tabindex, focuses main, and leaves it there so the next Tab enters the main content.
findings.evidence: <a class="skip-link" href="#main">; each <main id="main"> has no tabindex. focusElement sets tabindex="-1", calls focus(), then removeAttribute.

findings.summary: Public pages import Turbo Drive and never move focus to the new heading or main on turbo:load. After a navigation, focus falls back to the document instead of the page that just opened.
findings.fix: On turbo:load, set tabindex="-1" on the page h1 (or main) and call focus(). Skip that move when the visit already focused a hash target. Do not return focus to the link that started the visit.
findings.evidence: import "@hotwired/turbo-rails" with no turbo:load focus handler and no [autofocus] on these pages.

findings.summary: Region chips and directory jump links target headings that cannot take focus. Turbo scrolls to the heading and then removes a temporary tabindex, so Tab does not continue in that section.
findings.fix: Put tabindex="-1" on each homepage region article and each .county-head. Turbo will then leave focus on that heading, and the next Tab reaches the links inside the section.
findings.evidence: href="#region" and href="#group" point at elements that have an id and no tabindex.

findings.summary: FAQ hash links open the matching category and question but never focus the question button. Changing category hides the other sections, which can drop focus if it was inside the one that closed.
findings.fix: In openFromHash, focus the question button after openItem. If showCategory hides a section that contains document.activeElement, move focus to the category button for the section that stays open.
findings.evidence: openFromHash calls showCategory, openItem, and scrollIntoView, and never focus().

findings.summary: The home and map station search fields set outline-none and do not replace it with a ring, border, or focus-within style, so keyboard focus on those inputs is not visible.
findings.fix: Drop outline-none, or add focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-cyan-400 on .home-search input. That rule also covers the map search field inside .home-search.
findings.evidence: Unlayered outline-none with no focus or focus-visible variant overrides the base :focus-visible outline.

findings.summary: When home station results are open, the list is absolutely positioned over the popular-region chips and the links under them, and those links remain in the tab order.
findings.fix: Close the list when Tab leaves the combobox, or hide the chips from tab order while the list is open. Rendering .autocomplete in normal flow also stops it covering the links below.
findings.evidence: .autocomplete is absolute top-full; .popular-chips follows .search-stack and stays focusable.

findings.summary: Enter in map search always runs submitSearch, which goes to the first result, and also clicks the arrow-key highlight. The two handlers race, so the wrong station can open.
findings.fix: Handle Enter once. If searchActiveIndex is zero or greater, activate that option and return. Otherwise open the first result. Remove the extra Enter branch on the document keydown listener.
findings.evidence: keydown.enter->map#submitSearch awaits a fetch while onKeydown Enter clicks items[searchActiveIndex].

findings.summary: Closing map settings or mobile search hides the panel that contains the focused control and does not move focus back to the button that opened it.
findings.fix: After hiding settings, focus the settings button. After hiding mobile search, focus the Search stations button. Do that for the close buttons and for Escape in onKeydown.
findings.evidence: closeSettings and closeMobileSearch set hidden and never call focus(); Escape calls both.

findings.summary: The full-screen mobile map search covers the map, but the map container and attribution links stay tabbable, so focus can move to controls that are completely hidden.
findings.fix: While mobile search is open, set inert on the site header and the map surface, and remove inert when it closes. Return focus to the Search stations button.
findings.evidence: .map-mobile-search is absolute inset-0; data-search-open hides .map-chrome only, not the map canvas or attribution links.

findings.summary: The alerts and state filter card is sticky and has no max height. When it is taller than the viewport, jump links at the bottom cannot be scrolled into view while focused.
findings.fix: Give .state-directory .panel-card max-height: calc(100dvh - 3rem) and overflow-y: auto so the card scrolls. Tabbing to a jump link can then bring that link into view.
findings.evidence: .panel-card is sticky top-6 with no max-height or overflow; jump links sit at the bottom of that card.

findings.summary: On the map, the skip link and the site header are both z-50 and the header comes later, so the focused skip link is painted under the header bar and its focus indicator is not visible.
findings.fix: Raise .skip-link above z-50, or add isolate to .map-shell as .app-shell already does. Either one paints the focused skip link above the map header.
findings.evidence: .skip-link and .site-header are z-50; .map-shell is relative without isolate; .app-shell is isolate.

passed: No positive tabindex on the 12 public pages
Skip link is the first focusable control and stays off-screen until focused
On .app-shell pages, isolation keeps the focused skip link above the header
Mobile navigation: Escape closes the panel and focus returns to the menu button; it is not a keyboard trap
FAQ category buttons and question disclosures are native buttons, so Enter and Space work; hidden sections leave the tab order
Home station search supports Arrow Up, Arrow Down, Enter, and Escape from the combobox
Map pan and zoom remain available from the Leaflet map container, and the zoom controls are native buttons
No character-key shortcut runs unless the map or a search field is focused (2.1.4)
Contact, subscription, and state-directory fields that use outline-none also set a focus border and ring
notes: Code review only; focus was not exercised in a browser. Turbo View#focusElement removes a temporary tabindex after focus(); whether every browser then blurs that element was not run.

Map markers are created with keyboard: false. Marker clusters still use Leaflet's default keyboard: true. A marker popup is not keyboard-reachable; the Stations in view list in Map settings (40 links) plus zoom is the keyboard path. Desktop has no Search stations control; that button is hidden from the md breakpoint up for pointer users as well.

Arrow keys set aria-activedescendant on home and map search and never call scrollIntoView. Search returns at most 8 rows. Not filed on its own because DOM focus stays on the input; the missing input outline is KBD-005. The map list can clip the highlight inside overflow-y-auto.
The geolocation dialog cycles Tab while open. That trap is a modal and was left to the modal specialist.
About, FAQ, disclosures, alerts, and state pages place the h1 before main, so Skip to main content also skips the hero. Those heroes have no interactive controls.
Cloudflare Turnstile on the contact and subscription forms injects an iframe whose keyboard behavior is not in this repository.
Whether the open map settings panel fully covers the legend depends on viewport height and was not proven. gauges/show.html.erb, admin, and mailers were not reviewed.
